author: PlatinumTrade
name: PlatinumTrade Strategy Template
description: Scaffold a new PlatinumTrade strategy plugin project pinned to a specific SDK version, with settings sync from %LOCALAPPDATA%\PlatinumTrade\.

sdkVersion.description: Version of the Pt.Okx.Sdk NuGet package to pin in the generated project. Must be compatible with the host app.

targetFramework.description: Target framework moniker for the generated strategy project.

useProjectReference.description: Reference Pt.Okx.Sdk via a local ProjectReference (internal solution dev) instead of the NuGet PackageReference (external dev). Default is false = NuGet package.

skipRestore.description: If specified, skips the automatic 'dotnet restore' on create.

postActions.description: Restore NuGet packages required by this project.
